title: Expected eval findings
description: Semantic ground truth for one eval. Describes facts the agent must discover, never exact prose. An empty findings list means the correct behavior is to file no feedback.

findings.description: Each entry is one actionable finding the agent should report as protocol feedback.

type.description: Feedback protocol type the agent should file.

summary_keywords.description: Keywords expected (in normalized form) in the finding summary.

capability.description: Missing capability, e.g. "csv_export". Matched semantically, not verbatim.

endpoint.description: Endpoint involved, e.g. "/api/v1/customers/export". Suffix matching allowed.

required_evidence.description: Facts the agent output must establish (normalized semantic match).

forbidden_claims.description: Claims that must NOT appear (speculation, misdiagnosis, invented causes).

expect_no_feedback.description: True when the correct behavior is to file zero findings.

report_requirements.description: Facts the human-readable report must contain.

forbidden_report_claims.description: Claims the human-readable report must NOT contain.
